quest.title: Hereafter: The Trail of Pervases
quest.description: When you smell the aroma of Grilled Tiger Fish, you are suddenly reminded of someone who once helped you...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: What would you two like?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Three servings of Grilled Tiger Fish to go, please.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: You got it! Hang on for a moment, they'll be ready soon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Three servings? One for you, one for Paimon... Who's the last one for?

choices.text: I was thinking we could go see Pervases.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean gave-us-the-Seven-Star-Lamps-and-Censer Pervases?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, that's right. He did say that he missed the taste of Grilled Tiger Fish...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But isn't he gone now?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Even so, we can still pay our respects.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that makes sense. Let's go see him, then!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The last time that we met Pervases there, the temple was in a pretty sad state, and there were Treasure Hoarders in the area, too...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's hope that his statue hasn't been defaced...

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: Your three servings of Grilled Tiger Fish. Hold on to them, now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ooh, these smell so nice! C'mon, {NICKNAME}. Off to our next stop!

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Thank you, O mighty adeptus, thank you, mighty hero! ...Oh, what are the odds? We meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know us?

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: How could I forget you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're...

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: I'm Wang Ping'an! Don't you remember me?

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: Huh!? What? What "Starsnatcher"? ...Please, l—let's not bring that up, not in front of the adeptus...

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: I was just getting ready to make an offering at the temple of the Yaksha, Pervases.

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: But not long after I entered the mountains, I was set upon by those Treasure Hoarders... Thank you for saving me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a moment. What were you going to do at Pervases' temple?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Were you planning to do something bad to his statue?

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: No, no! I wouldn't dream of it!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Then what were you planning to do?

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: I... I wanted to restore the temple.

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: My plan today was to closely examine the temple's current condition and arrange for the purchase of the appropriate materials.

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: I never expected to be targeted halfway by Treasure Hoarders and forced to flee.

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: But as I ran, I... lost my way. As for the rest, you know what happened.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's speak further at the temple.

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: Right, this is hardly the place for conversation. Let's go to the temple first.

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: We'll speak there.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Go. I have other things to handle.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? You're leaving already?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...And he's gone.

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: Ah, good, good.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Why are you here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you here to see Pervases as well?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I was just passing through.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: What are you two here for?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're here to see Pervases!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Aw, but this place is in as much of a mess as last time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's a temple here, and a statue, too... Why doesn't anyone come to maintain this place?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps this place has been forgotten.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How could people forget something like this? The Yakshas are heroes who defended Liyue Harbor...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xiao, are... are you angry?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: No. The Yakshas did not perform their duty for any form of recognition.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Eh, let's not talk about this stuff right now. Grilled Tiger Fish first!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, and if you wanna have some, Xiao, we can give you half of our share each.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: It's fine...
Help! Help me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Did you hear that?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: There. Someone's calling for help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh!? What about the Grilled Tiger Fish? Paimon hasn't eaten yet!

talks.objective: Go back to the Pervases statue

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: This temple is in a terrible state...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, mister, where did you suddenly get the idea to come and fix this temple?

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Heh... Well, that's a long story...

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Back when I was pretending to be an adeptus, I gathered a lot of resources to help me keep up the act...

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: But remember how I swore to do good after that adeptus taught me a lesson? Well, after I returned, I was planning to destroy all those materials of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: But then I had a thought... Rather than destroying all this information, wouldn't it be better to write up my code of charlatanry and share it with others?

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: That way, I can help others to see through scams and cheaters...

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: To my surprise, the guidebook I wrote proved helpful to a lot of people. Even the Ministry of Civil Affairs said that it was very useful.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: They even provided me with some additional scam countermeasures to add to the stuff that I'd written myself...

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: To that end, they paid me a pretty hefty sum.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Apart from that guidebook, I'm currently planning to write a book about the Vigilant Yaksha.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Its purpose, of course, is to share the stories of the Vigilant Yaksha with as many people as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: That way, I'll be able to put the folklore knowledge I possess to good use.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: As for this temple to Pervases, I discovered it while I was compiling material for this second book.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: I found sources saying that this temple was built by our forebears to remember the Yaksha, Pervases.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: But I never expected to find the temple in such a state of disrepair...

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: When I returned and thought about it, I decided to fund the repair of this temple from my own pocket.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: After all, I, too, was guided back to the right path by an adeptus.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: I suppose repairing this temple can be considered atonement for my previous wrongdoings.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... sounds genuine enough...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: What do you mean "kinda"? I AM being genuine! One hundred percent genuine!

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: *sigh* Oh, fine, think whatever you like.

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: If you don't trust me, then come back once work has started. You'll see.

choices.text: That said, you've tried to fool us before...

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: But I gave all that up! I'm an upstanding citizen now! Didn't I swear to that before that adeptus?

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: *sigh* This place really is in a terrible state. The pillars are rotten, the planks are broken. At least the statue's still fine...

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Why hasn't anyone come to fix this place...
